article_title: Trump wants to be friends with Kim - but South Korea could pay the price

tasks.prompt: What is the article's main concern?
options: Trump's attempt to revive personal diplomacy with Kim could weaken South Korea's confidence in its US security alliance
South Korea has decided to form a military alliance with North Korea
The annual exercises were expanded to last an entire year
Kim Jong Un has agreed to abandon all nuclear weapons immediately
tasks.correct_answer: Trump's attempt to revive personal diplomacy with Kim could weaken South Korea's confidence in its US security alliance
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה בוחנת כיצד רצונו של טראמפ לחדש קשר אישי עם קים עלול לבוא על חשבון ביטחונה ואמונה של דרום קוריאה בברית עם ארה״ב.

tasks.prompt: What happened to the Ulchi Freedom Shield exercise?
options: It was moved permanently to North Korea
It was shortened from 11 days to five days
It was expanded to include 180,000 troops
It continued unchanged until the end of August
tasks.correct_answer: It was shortened from 11 days to five days
tasks.explanation_hebrew: התרגיל קוצר מ־11 ימים לחמישה והסתיים ביום שישי, מוקדם מהמתוכנן.

tasks.prompt: Approximately how many South Korean troops were involved in the exercise?
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מציינת שכ־18 אלף חיילים דרום־קוריאנים השתתפו בתרגיל.

tasks.prompt: How did Trump justify reducing the drills?
options: He said North Korea had joined the US-South Korea treaty
He said the troops were needed to build homes
He said Seoul had requested larger exercises
He described the drills as costly and hostile while stressing his good relationship with Kim
tasks.correct_answer: He described the drills as costly and hostile while stressing his good relationship with Kim
tasks.explanation_hebrew: טראמפ תיאר את התרגילים כיקרים ועוינים כלפי פיונגיאנג והדגיש את יחסיו הטובים עם קים.

tasks.prompt: What does “deterrence” mean in the article's security context?
options: Preventing an attack by showing the ability and willingness to respond
Offering praise to arrange a summit
Ending a treaty without consulting an ally
Moving troops away from a military base
tasks.correct_answer: Preventing an attack by showing the ability and willingness to respond
tasks.explanation_hebrew: deterrence היא הרתעה: מניעת תקיפה באמצעות הפגנת יכולת ונכונות להגיב.

tasks.prompt: Why was the abrupt reduction especially unsettling for Seoul?
options: It proved that North Korea controlled South Korea's parliament
It was a unilateral change with little or no advance consultation
It required South Korea to send all its troops abroad
It ended the mutual defence treaty automatically
tasks.correct_answer: It was a unilateral change with little or no advance consultation
tasks.explanation_hebrew: שינוי חד־צדדי וללא התרעה מספקת מעורר ספק אם החלטות ביטחוניות נוספות יתקבלו בלי להתחשב בבעלת הברית.

tasks.prompt: Give two reasons supporters of the joint exercises consider them important.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שני תפקידים של התרגילים במסגרת הברית והביטחון בחצי האי הקוריאני.
expected_points: They maintain readiness against a possible North Korean attack
They help US and South Korean forces train and operate together
They reinforce deterrence
They demonstrate the credibility of the longstanding alliance or security guarantees
They adapt training to North Korea's changing military capabilities

tasks.prompt: How could Trump's approach encourage South Korea to reduce its reliance on the United States?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר שרשרת סיבה ותוצאה בין חוסר הוודאות במדיניות ארה״ב לבין צעדים עצמאיים של סיאול.
expected_points: Abrupt or unilateral US decisions make security guarantees appear less predictable
Seoul may seek greater control of its wartime military command
South Korea may strengthen its own defence capabilities
Some may support a more independent deterrent
Reduced reliance would be an insurance against a capricious ally

tasks.prompt: Summarise the tension between Trump's diplomacy toward Kim and the security needs of South Korea.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציג את מטרת הצעד, את הוויתור שנעשה ואת הסיכון האפשרי לבעלת הברית.
expected_points: Trump wants renewed engagement or a personal meeting with Kim
He ordered a substantial reduction in joint exercises
The move may be intended as a concession or lure for North Korea
North Korea remains militarily threatening and seeks further leverage
South Korea depends on joint readiness and US guarantees
The decision may weaken trust and deterrence without securing a diplomatic return

tasks.prompt: Should military exercises be used as a concession to restart negotiations with North Korea? Evaluate the possible diplomatic benefit and the alliance risk described in the article.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לשקול תועלת דיפלומטית מול מחיר ביטחוני, להסתמך על פרטים מן הכתבה ולנסח מסקנה מנומקת.
expected_points: Reducing drills could signal openness and create space for diplomacy
Trump's personal rapport previously helped produce unprecedented meetings
A concession without reciprocity may strengthen Kim's negotiating position
Less training may weaken readiness or deterrence
Unilateral action can damage South Korean trust
A conditional or jointly agreed reduction could balance diplomacy and alliance security
